issue_context.title: Plex flooding the logs upon disconnect
issue_context.body:
### The problem

my NAS with Plex server sleeps during the night. Disconnect  was logged at first and then kept quiet in Homeassistant.log until restart the next morning.

As of now, the log is flooded.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.7.0.dev20220609

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Plex

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/plex/

<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
I remember fixing this for you in the past. Do you know with what release the behavior seemed to change?

meanwhile on 0610, so maybe tonight things will be better ;-)
